_notes: Stamina, morale, pace and rations for cities (design doc section 8); armies reuse these from build step 5. pace.output and the morale multiplier (morale / 100, never below morale.output_floor) scale everything a city produces; stamina / 100 additionally scales manpower only. rations.food_use scales food eaten. stamina/morale values are per-round changes applied at the end of the round. Doc-suggested values: pace output 0.75/1/1.25 and stamina +10/0/-10; rebellion 1% per morale point below 50. Placeholders (not in the doc yet): rations stamina/morale amounts, starvation morale penalty, output_floor (0 morale -> 0 output is an open question), and rebellion.population_share (share of population that rebels and leaves when the roll hits; they become savages in build step 9).
